transcription_convention.strikethrough: Text struck through in source is wrapped in ~~double tildes~~. Replacement value (if any) follows immediately after.
transcription_convention.verbatim_policy: Spelling errors / OCR artefacts in source are preserved as-is where legible (e.g., 'Lakh'/'Lac' variants, 'Crare' for 'Crore'). Illegible glyphs are marked 'illegible'.
transcription_convention.stamp_numbers: Numeric stamp codes are ink/rubber stamps embedded as images; where a digit sequence could not be reliably read it is marked 'illegible'.
transcription_convention.currency_note: INR figures given in Indian numbering (lakh/crore grouping) as printed in source. USD figures given as printed.
